name: VM Migration Execution Survey
description: Prompt for target VM limit, target OpenShift cluster, migration mode, and cutover parameters

spec.question_description: Specify the exact VM display name or inventory host limit pattern (e.g., winweb01-dev, db-vms). Must NOT be 'all' or '*'.
Select the destination OpenShift Virtualization cluster endpoint for this migration
Select or enter the destination namespace on the target OpenShift Virtualization cluster
Perform online CBT disk replication before final cutover shutdown
ISO-8601 UTC Timestamp for delayed cutover (e.g. 2026-09-24T03:00:00Z). Leave blank for immediate cutover upon initial sync completion.
